why: The agent diffed only commit 1 against commit 3 and never diffed commit 2 against commit 1 (or 3 against 2). So it did not gather the diffs since the last deploy per commit, and its message to the owner admitted this with 'adds inspect and renew, or one of them'. The diff shown to the person was therefore incomplete and ambiguous. The agent did avoid deciding on its own and asked the owner to confirm, but the first 'must' item was not met.
